mentions.name: Six GPUs, One x16 Slot
mentions.description: A DIY multi-GPU hardware build documented in a blog post, assembling six consumer GPUs to run from a single PCIe x16 slot to piece together a performant machine, exploring the many parts and combinations available in consumer GPU hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been fooling around with a lot of consumer GPU hardware and having a fun time. There are so many rabbit holes and interesting parts available to piece a Rube Goldberg of a performant clanker together.

https://doug.sh/posts/six-gpus-one-x16-slot/
mentions.author: dougcalobrisi
